sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: LARGE-SCALE PATTERN AMPLIFICATION IS EXPECTED DURING THE PERIOD. TO THE NORTH OF A WESTWARD-SHIFTING ANTICYCLONE OVER THE SOUTHERN PLAINS...AN AMPLIFYING/MODERATELY STRONG BELT OF MID/HIGH-LEVEL WESTERLIES ARE EXPECTED FROM THE WEST COAST/GREAT BASIN TO THE NORTHERN PLAINS/UPPER MIDWEST...SOUTHEASTWARD TO THE MID-ATLANTIC STATES/CAROLINAS.

sections.title: UPPER MIDWEST AND UPPER/MIDDLE MS RIVER VALLEY
sections.text: A FEW STRONG STORMS MAY PERSIST/DEVELOP EASTWARD EARLY TODAY FROM EASTERN ND INTO NORTHERN MN...WITH SOME HAIL/WIND REMAINING POSSIBLE DURING THE DAY. HOWEVER...A MUCH MORE WIDESPREAD/POTENT SEVERE WEATHER RISK IS EXPECTED TO EVOLVE LATER THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING. A MID-LEVEL IMPULSE/SPEED MAX AND RELATED COOL POCKET PER OBSERVED SATURDAY EVENING UPPER-AIR DATA OVER THE NORTHERN ROCKIES IS EXPECTED TO REACH THE EASTERN DAKOTAS/MN BY LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING. AS THE MID/UPPER-LEVEL PATTERN OTHERWISE AMPLIFIES WITH STRENGTHENING WINDS ALOFT...DEEP CONVECTIVE INITIATION APPEARS MOST PROBABLE ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE FAR EASTERN DAKOTAS AND WESTERN MN /AND POSSIBLY NORTHWEST IA/ BY LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING...PARTICULARLY IN VICINITY OF A WEAK SURFACE LOW AND SOUTHEASTWARD-EXTENDING WARM FRONT. THE REGION WILL BE ON THE NORTHEAST PERIPHERY OF A ROCKIES/NORTH-CENTRAL PLAINS ELEVATED MIXED LAYER...WITH PREVALENT WARM SECTOR LOWER 70S F SURFACE DEWPOINTS CONTRIBUTING TO A VERY UNSTABLE AIR MASS WITH 3000-5000 J/KG MLCAPE ESPECIALLY ACROSS PORTIONS OF MN/IA INTO IL. MODEST LATE DAY/NOCTURNAL STRENGTHENING AND VEERING WITH HEIGHT OF TROPOSPHERIC WINDS WILL YIELD SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF SEV

sections.title: LOWER/MIDDLE OH VALLEY TO TN VALLEY/APPALACHIANS
sections.text: CONVECTIVE OUTFLOWS/DIFFERENTIAL HEATING AS A BYPRODUCT OF OVERNIGHT CONVECTION ACROSS IL/INDIANA/KY/OH WILL MODULATE A WAVY FRONTAL CORRIDOR THAT OTHERWISE EXTENDS NORTHWEST-SOUTHEASTWARD ACROSS THE REGION. OBSERVATION INDICATIONS EARLY IN THE OVERNIGHT ARE THAT A CONVECTIVELY ENHANCED /35 KT/ BELT OF MID-LEVEL FLOW /PROBABLE MCV/ IS ASSOCIATED WITH THE AFOREMENTIONED CONVECTION...AND THIS SHOULD AT LEAST BE SOME FACTOR IN RENEWED STORM DEVELOPMENT/ORGANIZATION INTO THIS AFTERNOON AS IT SPREADS SOUTHEASTWARD ACROSS THE REGION. WITH STRONG DESTABILIZATION EXPECTED ON THE SOUTHERN FRINGE OF MORNING CONVECTION...AND ON THE SOUTH/SOUTHWEST PERIPHERY OF THE EFFECTIVE FRONTAL ZONE...THE RELATIVELY COLLOCATED BELT OF MODERATE WEST-NORTHWESTERLY WINDS ALOFT WILL SUPPORT THE DEVELOPMENT/INTENSIFICATION OF SOUTHEASTWARD-MOVING MULTICELLS/LINE SEGMENTS CAPABLE OF MOSTLY DAMAGING WINDS.

sections.title: COASTAL SOUTHEAST STATES/FL PENINSULA
sections.text: ON THE EASTERN PERIPHERY OF THE SOUTH-CENTRAL CONUS UPPER RIDGE...THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD AGAIN DEVELOP/SPREAD SOUTH-SOUTHWESTWARD ACROSS THE REGION WITHIN A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS. THE STRONGER STORMS WILL BE CAPABLE OF DOWNBURSTS WITH LOCALIZED WIND DAMAGE THIS AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING.

sections.title: NM/EASTERN AZ
sections.text: SOME SUSTAINED MULTICELLULAR STORMS ARE AGAIN LIKELY TO DEVELOP/INTENSIFY ACROSS THE REGION THIS AFTERNOON. THIS WILL BE AIDED BY A MODESTLY ENHANCED BELT OF SOUTH-SOUTHWESTERLY MID-LEVEL WINDS ON THE WESTERN PERIPHERY OF SOUTHERN PLAINS UPPER RIDGE. A FEW INSTANCES OF SEVERE HAIL AND/OR WIND WILL BE POSSIBLE MAINLY THIS AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING. ..GUYER/PICCA.. 07/12/2015

sections.title: UPPER MIDWEST THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: ANOTHER DAY OF EVAPOTRANSPIRATION IS EXPECTED ACROSS THE UPPER MIDWEST WITH A SOMEWHAT SHALLOW BOUNDARY LAYER TRAPPED BENEATH AN ELEVATED MIXED LAYER...IN COMBINATION WITH MATURING CORN CROPS AND SUFFICIENT SOIL MOISTURE. THE ADDITION OF MOISTURE DURING THE DAY WILL SUPPORT BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE LOW-MID 70S ALONG AND IMMEDIATELY SW OF NNW-SSE ORIENTED FRONT THAT IS EXPECTED TO MOVE NEWD FROM WRN IA/ERN DAKOTAS THIS MORNING TO THE CENTRAL AND ERN MN/IA BY LATER THIS AFTERNOON. STRONG BUOYANCY /MLCAPE VALUES OF 3000-4000 J PER KG/ IS EXPECTED THROUGH THIS CORRIDOR GIVEN THE LOW-LEVEL MOISTENING AND SURFACE HEATING BENEATH STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES. MEANWHILE...A SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER WY THIS MORNING WILL MOVE OVER SD THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING...THEN THE WAVE WILL CREST THE SRN GREAT PLAINS UPPER RIDGE AND BEGIN TO MOVE SEWD OVER THE UPPER MS VALLEY TONIGHT. THE APPROACH OF THIS WAVE WILL MAINTAIN A SURFACE TROUGH ACROSS THE ERN DAKOTAS THIS AFTERNOON...WHICH WILL SERVE TO FOCUS THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT BY MID-LATE AFTERNOON AS DEEPER SURFACE MIXING ERODES THE CAP. EFFECTIVE BULK WIND DIFFERENCES AROUND 35 KT WILL COMBINE WITH THE LARGE CAPE TO SUPPORT A RISK FOR SUPERCELLS WI

sections.title: KY/TN AREA TODAY
sections.text: A SMALL MCS OVER KY HAS BECOME LESS ORGANIZED THE PAST COUPLE OF HOURS. DESTABILIZATION ON THE W/SW FLANK OF THE MCS...AND SOME ENHANCEMENT OF WNWLY MIDLEVEL FLOW ON THE SW PERIPHERY OF A REMNANT MCV...COULD SUPPORT SOME INCREASE IN THE RISK FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING GUSTS BY MIDDAY INTO THE AFTERNOON WITH NEW STORM DEVELOPMENT. CONFIDENCE IS LOW IN THE DETAILS OF CONVECTIVE EVOLUTION...BUT WILL MAINTAIN A SLIGHT RISK FOR THE AFOREMENTIONED POSSIBILITY.

ALTHOUGH DEEP-LAYER SHEAR IS RELATIVELY WEAK IN KY AND THE TN VALLEY...SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER TO MID 70S F AND MODERATE INSTABILITY MAY BE ENOUGH FOR A MARGINAL SEVERE THREAT THIS AFTERNOON. WHILE THE HRRR SUGGESTS THAT A LINEAR MCS WILL DEVELOP AND MOVE IN MORE OF AN EASTERLY FASHION ACROSS CNTRL MN INTO WRN WI...NAM AND GFS SOLUTIONS MOVE THE MCS SSEWD TOWARD NERN IA. THIS DIFFERENCE SUGGESTS THAT UNCERTAINTY REMAINS BUT THAT THE MODERATE RISK SHOULD BE CLOSE TO THE GREATEST SEVERE THREAT...REF MCD 1378. sections.title: UPPER MIDWEST
sections.text: LARGE-SCALE PATTERN AMPLIFICATION WILL CONTINUE TO OCCUR OVER THE DAKOTAS/UPPER MIDWEST TONIGHT...HIGHLIGHTED BY AN UPPER LOW OVER ND/ADJACENT CANADIAN PRAIRIES AND A SOUTHERN-PERIPHERAL BELT OF STRENGTHENING MID/HIGH-LEVEL WESTERLIES ACROSS THE DAKOTAS/MN PER 00Z UPPER-AIR AND RECENT REGIONAL WSR-88D VWP DATA. A SURFACE FRONT EXTENDS FROM NORTHWEST/CENTRAL MN SOUTHEASTWARD INTO THE MIDWEST/MIDDLE OH RIVER VALLEY. NEAR/SOUTHWEST OF THIS FRONT...REGIONAL FORECAST SOUNDINGS SAMPLE AN ENVIRONMENT GENERALLY CHARACTERIZED BY A VERY MOIST/STRONGLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS AND MODERATE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR /ALBEIT WITH RELATIVELY WEAK LOW-MID-LEVEL WINDS/. THE 00Z OBSERVED SOUNDING FROM MINNEAPOLIS FEATURED AROUND 4000 J/KG OF MLCAPE /WITH ADJUSTED LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE PROFILE/ WITH A 17.5 G/KG MEAN-MIXING RATIO AND VERY STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATE OF 8.1 C/KM. WHILE LOW/MID TROPOSPHERIC FLOW WAS OBSERVED TO BE RELATIVELY WEAK...50+ KT HIGHER-LEVEL WESTERLIES WERE NOTED WITH AN EFFECTIVE SHEAR OF 38 KT. AS IS ALREADY OCCURRING EARLY THIS EVENING ACROSS CENTRAL MN...FURTHER UPSCALE QUASI-LINEAR GROWTH IS HIGHLY LIKELY THIS EVENING WITH SUBSEQUENT SOUTHEASTWARD FORWARD PROPAGATION/ACCELERATION INTO A VER

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED HAIL WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR SOME STONES APPROACHING 1 INCH AND PERHAPS LOCALLY STRONG WINDS WILL POSE A MARGINAL SEVERE THREAT THE REST OF THIS MORNING INTO EARLY AFTERNOON ACROSS NORTHEAST AND EAST-CENTRAL MN /NORTH OF THE TWIN CITIES...CLOSER TO DULUTH/...AND INTO NORTHWEST WI...AND PERHAPS FAR WESTERN UPPER MI. WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED AT THIS TIME...THOUGH CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY AND GOES-R CLOUD TOP COOLING AND OVERSHOOTING TOP PRODUCTS HAVE CONTINUED TO INDICATE A FEW STRONG STORMS THIS MORNING ACROSS EAST-CENTRAL MN /CROW WING AND AITKIN COUNTIES/ WITH GOES-R PRODUCTS SHOWING MOST RECENT OVERSHOOTING TOP IN NORTH-CENTRAL MN /SHIFTING EAST FROM BELTRAMI INTO ITASCA COUNTIES/. MID MORNING SURFACE ANALYSIS SHOWED A PORTION OF A WARM FRONT EXTENDING FROM SOUTHEAST ND INTO WEST CENTRAL MN...AND THEN SOUTHEAST THROUGH SOUTHERN MN...WITH THE ONGOING TSTMS LOCATED WELL NORTH-NORTHEAST OF THIS FRONT. STORMS SHOULD BE MAINLY ELEVATED THROUGH THE REST OF THE MORNING INTO THE EARLY AFTERNOON...WITH ACTIVITY LIKELY BEING SUSTAINED BY LOW-LEVEL WAA WITHIN THE TERMINUS OF A 15-25 KT SWLY LLJ AND ASCENT ATTENDANT TO A LOW AMPLITUDE MIDLEVEL IMPULSE. DESPITE THESE FACTORS FOR FORCING FOR ASCENT AS THE IMPULSE TOPS THE NORTHERN PORTION OF AN UPPER RIDGE...RELATIVELY WARM MIDLEVEL TEMPERATURES APPEAR TO BE LIMITING HAIL GROWTH SO FAR THIS MORNING WITH MOST REPORTS REMAINING SUB-SEVERE COMBINED WITH HEAVY RAINFALL. HOWEVER...SINCE ENOUGH FORCING FOR ASCENT APPEARS TO EXIST TO SUSTAIN UPDRAFTS...STRONGER CORES COULD PROVE FAVORABLE AT PRODUCING NEAR SEVERE AND/OR SEVERE HAIL. MOST CAMS AND RECENT HRRR RUNS SUGGEST STORM COVERAGE SHOULD REMAIN LOW WITH SOME DIMINISHING TREND SUCH THAT A SEVERE TSTM WATCH WOULD NOT BE WARRANTED...BUT THE THIS REGION WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR UPSCALE GROWTH AS SUGGESTED BY THE 00Z 4-KM NSSL AND 00Z ARW HIGH-RES.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS POSSIBLE AS TSTM ACTIVITY CONTINUES. ISOLATED AND MARGINAL NATURE OF THE SVR THREAT WILL PREVENT THE NEED FOR A WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS A WELL-DEFINED OUTFLOW BOUNDARY PUSHING EWD ACROSS THE CNTRL FL PENINSULA...PROVIDING IN THE IMPETUS FOR RAPIDLY DEVELOPING TSTMS. 12Z TBW SOUNDING SAMPLED A VERY MOIST ENVIRONMENT ACROSS THE REGION WITH A PW VALUE OF 1.97 INCHES /NEAR THE 90TH PERCENTILE BASED ON SPC SOUNDING CLIMATOLOGY/. THIS MOIST ENVIRONMENT COUPLED WITH TEMPERATURES ALREADY IN THE LOW 90S IS CONTRIBUTING TO MODERATE INSTABILITY WITH RECENT MESOANALYSIS ESTIMATED MLCAPE OVER 2500 J PER KG. KINEMATIC ENVIRONMENT IS WEAK...SUGGESTING A MAINLY PULSE STORM MODE. PRIMARY THREAT IS SOME DAMAGING WIND GUSTS RESULTING FROM CELL MERGERS AND/OR PRECIP LOADING. MARGINAL SVR THREAT PRECLUDES THE NEED FOR A WW.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FEW STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS SOUTH-CENTRAL KY INTO MIDDLE AND EAST TN AND FAR NORTH GA...POTENTIALLY BECOMING CAPABLE OF PRODUCING LOCALLY STRONG WINDS AND SOME HAIL POSSIBLE IN STRONGER CORES.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG DIABATIC HEATING THROUGH THE LATE MORNING INTO THE EARLY AFTERNOON HAD WEAKENED THE CAP SUFFICIENTLY ALLOWING FOR NEW SURFACE-BASED STORM DEVELOPMENT FROM CENTRAL KY SSEWD THROUGH PORTIONS OF MIDDLE AND EAST TN TO FAR NORTH GA. THIS ACTIVITY IS GENERALLY DEVELOPING IN VICINITY OF A NORTH-SOUTH ORIENTED WARM FRONT ANALYZED ON A MID-DAY SURFACE MAP EXTENDING FROM AN AREA OF LOW PRESSURE IN CENTRAL IND THROUGH CENTRAL KY AND MIDDLE TN /BETWEEN BNA AND CSV/ INTO NORTH GA. DESPITE WEAK MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES...THE SURFACE HEATING OF A RATHER MOIST AIR MASS /PW VALUES AROUND 1.75 INCHES/ HAS RESULTED IN MODERATELY STRONG INSTABILITY ALREADY WITH MLCAPE OF 2000-2500 J/KG. WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWED A WEAK MIDLEVEL IMPULSE THAT LIKELY AIDED TSTMS ACROSS FAR NORTHEAST MO LAST NIGHT AND WAS NOW MOVING SOUTH THROUGH CENTRAL KY TOWARD MIDDLE AND EAST TN. FORCING FOR ASCENT IN VICINITY OF THE WARM FRONT AND ALONG THE TRACK OF THE IMPULSE SHOULD SUPPORT ADDITIONAL STORMS THIS AFTERNOON. WEAK BULK SHEAR SUGGESTS STORM MODE SHOULD REMAIN MULTICELLULAR.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: PORTIONS OF EASTERN ND INTO NORTHWEST AND WEST-CENTRAL MN ARE BEING MONITORED FOR WATCH ISSUANCE WITH EASTERN ND AND NORTHWEST MN EXPECTED TO HAVE A WATCH COORDINATED FOR AND ISSUED SOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLY AFTERNOON SURFACE ANALYSES SHOWED AN AREA OF LOW PRESSURE IN SOUTHEAST ND NEAR THE SD BORDER WITH A WELL DEFINED WARM FRONT EXTENDING TO THE SOUTHEAST THROUGH FAR NORTHEAST SD AND ADJACENT WEST-CENTRAL TO SOUTH-CENTRAL MN INTO SOUTHEAST IA. THE PORTION OF THIS FRONT IN WEST-CENTRAL MN HAS BEEN RE-ENFORCED BY A WWD MOVING CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM EARLIER CONVECTION OVER EAST-CENTRAL MN. MEANWHILE...A BOUNDARY EXTENDED GENERALLY N-S ACROSS CENTRAL ND TO A SECOND LOW OVER SOUTHEAST SASKATCHEWAN. STRONG HEATING ALONG THIS LATTER N-S BOUNDARY COMBINED WITH COOLING MIDLEVEL TEMPERATURES AS CONFIRMED BY SPECIAL 18Z SOUNDINGS IN EXTREME SRN MANITOBA AND AT INL ATTENDANT TO A MIDLEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH PROGRESSING EWD ACROSS ND. THESE THERMODYNAMICS COMBINED WITH A VERY RICH BOUNDARY LAYER /SURFACE DEW POINTS IN THE 70S HAVE RESULTED IN AN EXTREMELY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT. FORCING FOR ASCENT WITH THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND INCREASING CONVERGENCE ALONG THE N-S BOUNDARY IN CENTRAL ND APPEARS TO BE SUPPORTING A RECENT INCREASE IN TSTM COVERAGE AND INTENSITY ACROSS NORTH-CENTRAL ND PER TRENDS IN MRMS 5-9-KM CAPPI DATA. STRENGTHENING BULK SHEAR WILL SUPPORT MULTICELLS AND SUPERCELLS WITH LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS THE PRIMARY THREATS GIVEN THE DEGREE OF INSTABILITY AND STEEPENING LAPSE RATES. LOW-LEVEL SHEAR IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN WEAKER ACROSS EASTERN ND INTO NORTHWEST MN SUGGESTING LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS ACROSS THIS PORTION OF THE DISCUSSION AREA AS COMPARED TO POINTS FARTHER TO THE SOUTH/SOUTHEAST.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SVR TSTMS CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS...LARGE HAIL...AND POTENTIALLY A TORNADO OR TWO ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP ACROSS PART OF THIS REGION. WHILE SOME UNCERTAINTY EXISTS REGARDING THE TIMING OF CONVECTIVE INITIATION...A WW WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED ONCE TSTMS DO DEVELOP.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT SATELLITE IMAGERY DEPICTS A SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING THROUGH CNTRL SD. ASCENT FROM THIS SHORTWAVE IS CONTRIBUTING TO THE ACCAS FIELD ALONG THE SD/MN BORDER AS WELL AS THE ELEVATED TSTM ACTIVITY CURRENTLY ONGOING ACROSS ERN ND AND W-CNTRL MN. SURFACE ANALYSIS ALSO REVEALS A TROUGH AXIS EXTENDING FROM A LOW OVER SW MANITOBA THROUGH THE CNTRL DAKOTAS. RECENT VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY HAS RECENTLY SHOWN AN INCREASE IN CU ALONG THIS BOUNDARY. AIRMASS DOWNSTREAM OF THIS SURFACE BOUNDARY AND SHORTWAVE TROUGH IS VERY UNSTABLE WITH TEMPERATURES IN THE 90S...DEWPOINTS IN THE MID 70S...AND MLCAPE ESTIMATED OVER 4000 J PER KG. THERE IS STILL SOME UNCERTAINTY AS TO WHEN CONVECTIVE INITIATION OCCURS OVER THE AREA...ESPECIALLY SINCE IT APPEARS SOME MODEST LARGE SCALE HEIGHT RISES ARE IMPINGING ON THE AREA. HOWEVER...GUIDANCE IS CONSISTENT THAT INITIATION DOES OCCUR. ONCE INITIATION OCCURS...EXPLOSIVE TSTM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED WITH STRONG UPDRAFTS AND SUFFICIENT SHEAR LEADING TO AN INITIAL SUPERCELL MODE. AS A RESULT...LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WINDS AND TORNADOES ARE ALL POSSIBLE.. TRENDS ACROSS THE REGION WILL BE MONITORED CLOSELY WITH WW ISSUANCE LIKELY NEEDED TO COVER THE EXPECTED SEVERE THREAT ONCE INITIATION APPEARS IMMINENT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE POTENTIAL EXISTS FOR A FEW STRONG/SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS THIS EVENING...WITH LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WINDS AS THE PRIMARY THREATS. HOWEVER...DUE TO THE RELATIVELY LIMITED SPATIAL NATURE OF THE THREAT...WW ISSUANCE IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VIS SATELLITE IMAGERY LATE THIS AFTERNOON EXHIBITS GROWING CU/TCU ACROSS PORTIONS OF N-CNTRL KS/S-CNTRL NEB...GENERALLY NEAR AN ANALYZED SFC TROUGH/WEAK LOW. INDEED...THE LATEST WSR-88D MOSAIC INDICATED INITIATION HAS OCCURRED OVER ELLIS AND GRAHAM COUNTIES IN KS. AMPLE INSOLATION HAS YIELDED SFC TEMPS IN THE 90S/LOWER 100S...WITH A WELL-MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER PRESENT. IN COMBINATION WITH SFC DEW POINTS IN THE UPPER 60S/LOWER 70S...STEEP LAPSE RATES ALOFT HAVE YIELDED STRONG BUOYANCY...WITH MLCAPE VALUES ON THE ORDER OF 2500-4500 J/KG /PER MESOANALYSIS DATA/. WHILE CONVECTIVE COVERAGE WILL LIKELY BE SOMEWHAT LIMITED DUE TO A LACK OF STRONG FORCING FOR ASCENT AND SOME DRY AIR AROUND THE LFC...ANY UPDRAFTS THAT BECOME WELL-ROOTED/SUSTAINED IN THE BL SHOULD BE ABLE TO UTILIZE ENHANCED FLOW ALOFT AND EFFECTIVE SHEAR UPWARDS OF 40 KTS. THE PRESENCE OF AMPLE BUOYANCY IN THE HAIL-GROWTH ZONE SHOULD OFFER A LARGE-HAIL THREAT...AND THE WELL-MIXED/MOIST BL SHOULD ENABLE A STRONG-WIND THREAT FOR A FEW HOURS THIS EVENING. HOWEVER...DUE TO THE AFOREMENTIONED ISSUES IN TERMS OF SPARSE CONVECTIVE COVERAGE...WW ISSUANCE IS NOT ANTICIPATED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TWO CLUSTERS OF INTENSE STORMS MOVING INTO PORTIONS OF WRN AND NRN MN WILL PRODUCE HIGH WINDS...LARGE HAIL...AND POSSIBLY A TORNADO OR TWO. THE GREATEST SEVERE WEATHER RISK WILL EXIST OVER KITTSON...MARSHAL...AND ROSEAU COUNTIES...IN NWRN MN...AND GRANT AND OTTER TAIL COUNTIES IN WEST-CNTRL MN...OVER THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TWO CLUSTERS OF INTENSE STORMS APPEAR TO BE LOCATED VERY NEAR OR COINCIDENT WITH WEAK FRONTAL WAVES OF LOW PRESSURE THAT HAVE DEVELOPED ALONG A STRONG WARM FRONT EXTENDING SEWD FROM NEAR THE ND/MN BORDER. NRN CLUSTER CONSOLIDATION APPEARS TO HAVE BROAD ROTATION AND WILL CONTINUE TO MOVE ACROSS AN AXIS OF STRONG INSTABILITY OVER THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS. RECENT SIGNS OF UPSCALE GROWTH COULD BE AN INDICATION OF AN INCREASING DAMAGING WIND THREAT WITH THESE STORMS AS THEY DEVELOP EAST ACROSS KITTSON...MARSHAL...AND ROSEAU COUNTIES...AND EVENTUALLY INTO LAKE OF THE WOODS AND BELTRAMI COUNTIES. IN ADDITION TO DAMAGING WINDS...A BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO CANNOT BE RULED OUT. THE STORM COMPLEX ACROSS THE SRN PORTION OF THE WATCH AREA WAS ALSO EXHIBITING ROTATION AND WAS ANCHORED BY AN INTENSE SUPERCELL OVER OTTER TAIL COUNTY. THIS VIGOROUS DEEP CONVECTION WAS VERY NEAR THE SFC WARM FRONT WHERE STRONGER EFFECTIVE SRH AND LOWER LFC SHOULD CONTRIBUTE TO A GREATER LIKELIHOOD FOR A TORNADO IN THE SHORT-TERM. THIS POTENTIAL APPEARS MOST LIKELY OVER NRN GRANT COUNTY AND WILL MOVE TOWARD DOUGLAS COUNTY...AND TORNADO WATCH 406...WITHIN THE NEXT HOUR.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ORGANIZING COMPLEX OF SEVERE CONVECTION SHOULD ACCELERATE SEWD ACROSS CNTRL/SRN MN THIS EVENING...WITH THE PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT TRANSITIONING TO DAMAGING WINDS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AS OF 0030Z...AN EXPANSIVE COMPLEX OF SEVERE CONVECTION WAS ORGANIZING OVER PORTIONS OF CNTRL MN...AIDED BY LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE NEAR A WARM FRONT EXTENDING SE FROM A SFC LOW IN ERN ND. ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF THIS COMPLEX...EXCEPTIONAL BUOYANCY /E.G. MLCAPE VALUES OF AROUND 4000-5000 J PER KG/ IS SUSTAINING NEW CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT...FAVORING S/SEWD PROPAGATION. RADAR-DEPICTED INFLOW VELOCITIES HAVE EXHIBITED A TENDENCY TO RAPIDLY INCREASE WITH NASCENT CONVECTION ALONG THE SWRN FLANK OF THE LINE...SUGGESTIVE OF INTENSE UPDRAFT DEVELOPMENT FROM AMPLE BUOYANCY AHEAD OF THE LINE. MOREOVER...WITH SFC TEMPS BEHIND THE LINE NOW IN THE MID/UPPER 60S...A MATURING COLD POOL SHOULD FAVOR A RAPID SEWD ACCELERATION OF THE LINE. AS SUCH...THE OVERALL THREAT APPEARS TO BE TRANSITIONING TO PRIMARILY DAMAGING WINDS...AND IT SHOULD PERSIST AS THE COMPLEX PROGRESSES SEWD ALONG THE INSTABILITY GRADIENT TOWARDS THE TWIN CITIES/POINTS WEST. ADDITIONALLY...THE THREAT FOR A BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO WILL CONTINUE...PRIMARILY NEAR THE FRONT WHERE SRH IS ENHANCED. FARTHER S/SW ACROSS ERN SD/SWRN MN/NRN IA...DESPITE STRONG BUOYANCY...CONVECTION HAS BEEN FAIRLY MINIMAL...POSSIBLY DUE TO A COMBINATION OF DRY-AIR ENTRAINMENT AND INSUFFICIENT LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE. THEREFORE...THE SEVERE THREAT APPEARS SOMEWHAT QUESTIONABLE ACROSS THIS PORTION OF WW 406...AND MORE COUNTIES MAY BE CLEARED EARLY IF THIS TREND CONTINUES. ..PICCA.. 07/13/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED SEVERE STORMS WITH HAIL AND STRONG/DAMAGING WINDS REMAIN A POSSIBILITY OVER PORTIONS OF ERN ND AND NWRN MN THIS EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A COMPLEX MESOSCALE ENVIRONMENT HAS EVOLVED ACROSS THE WATCH AREA WITH TWO WELL-DEFINED MESO-HIGH CENTERS SITUATED ACROSS WRN MN AND OUTFLOW-STABILIZED AIR EMANATING FROM BOTH. CORRIDORS OF UNPERTURBED/UNSTABLE AIR REMAIN AND MAY CONTRIBUTE TO ADDITIONAL STRONG TO SEVERE STORM DEVELOPMENT PRIOR TO WATCH EXPIRATION AT 03 UTC/10 PM CDT. A MODEST COLD FRONT WAS APPROACHING THE WRN EDGE OF THE WATCH WITH QUASI-LINEAR DEVELOPMENT OCCURRING ON THIS BOUNDARY AS IT MOVES EAST INTO REMAINING INSTABILITY OVER ERN ND. AT PRESENT SPEED OF 40KT THIS CONVECTION WILL BE WELL INTO THE STABILIZED AIR ACROSS NWRN MN BY 03 UTC. ELSEWHERE...A LINE OF VIGOROUS STORMS ERUPTED EARLIER AMIDST THE STRONG LOW LEVEL CONVERGENCE BETWEEN THE TWO COLLIDING OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES FROM NORMAN COUNTY NEWD TO WRN BELTRAMI COUNTY MN. IT APPEARS THIS CONVECTION WAS ENCOUNTERING LIMITED BUOYANCY IN THE WAKE OF EARLIER ACTIVITY. CURRENT INDICATIONS SUGGEST SEVERE WEATHER POTENTIAL SHOULD BE ENDING AROUND THE TIME OF SCHEDULED WATCH EXPIRATION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WITH A CHANCE FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL WILL MOVE INTO NWRN AND WEST-CNTRL WI LATER THIS EVENING. A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL PROBABLY BE NEEDED FOR SOME OF THIS AREA PRIOR TO 0500 UTC/MIDNIGHT CDT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EVOLVING LARGE MCS ACROSS CNTRL MN WILL TRACK GENERALLY SEWD WITH GREATEST SEVERE WEATHER POTENTIAL LIKELY FOCUSED ALONG A WARM FRONT SITUATED FROM NW TO SE ACROSS THE SRN HALF OF MN FOR THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. INTENSE TSTM CORES REMAIN PERSISTENT IN THE ERN PORTION OF THE MCS WELL NORTH OF THE SFC WARM FRONT AND WERE CURRENTLY CROSSING CARLTON...PINE...AND KANABEC COUNTIES IN EAST-CNTRL MN. THESE CONSOLIDATING CORES WILL MOVE INTO EXTREME NWRN WI SHORTLY AND MAY POSE SOME CHANCE FOR STRONG WIND GUSTS. AS UPPER FORCING FOR ASCENT STRENGTHENS ACROSS THE REGION TONIGHT WITH APPROACH OF SHORTWAVE TROUGH...AND STORMS CONTINUE TO CONSOLIDATE AMIDST VERY STRONG INSTABILITY...A MORE WIDESPREAD HIGH WIND THREAT SHOULD SPREAD ESEWD INTO WI. THIS SCENARIO WILL PROBABLY REQUIRE A NEW SEVERE TSTM WATCH...MOST LIKELY PRIOR TO 0500 UTC/MIDNIGHT CDT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AS THE PRIMARY THREAT HAS SHIFTED TO DAMAGING WINDS...PORTIONS OF WW 406 WILL LIKELY BE REPLACED BY A NEW SEVERE TSTM WATCH BEFORE 03Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTION HAS ORGANIZED INTO A FAIRLY STOUT MCS LATE THIS EVENING...WITH CELLS EXTENDING FROM STEARNS COUNTY TO PINE COUNTY MN AS OF 0230Z. THIS SYSTEM SHOULD CONTINUE TO ACCELERATE NEAR/ALONG A WARM FRONT STRETCHING SEWD INTO FAR WRN WI. AS THE MATURE COLD POOL /E.G. SFC PRES RISES OF 2-3 MB PER 2 HRS AND SFC TEMPS IN THE 60S/ ADVANCES TO THE SE AROUND 30 KTS...SUFFICIENT BUOYANCY AHEAD OF THE OUTFLOW SHOULD MAINTAIN VIGOROUS UPDRAFT DEVELOPMENT AND A CONTINUATION OF THE WIND THREAT. ALTHOUGH THE TORNADO THREAT IS NON-ZERO /ESPECIALLY IN THE VICINITY OF THE STATIONARY FRONT/...THE PRIMARY POTENTIAL FOR DAMAGING WINDS WILL LIKELY NECESSITATE REPLACEMENT OF WW 406 WITH A NEW SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH PRIOR TO 03Z...GENERALLY ACROSS S-CNTRL/SERN MN AND WRN WI /SEE MCD 1384 FOR MORE DETAILS TO THE EAST OF THIS MCD AREA/.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SPORADIC STRONG TO OCCASIONALLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS TO 50KT REMAIN POSSIBLE AS MATURE MCS SPREADS SOUTHEAST ALONG SERN MN/WRN WI BORDER LATE TONIGHT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ABUNDANT INSTABILITY ACROSS SRN MN AND MUCH OF IA SHOULD CONTINUE TO FUEL INTENSE STORM UPDRAFTS ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF MATURE COLD POOL SPREADING SEWD AROUND 35KT. IR CLOUD TOP CANOPY CONTINUES TO EXPAND WITH LITTLE CHANGE IN COLD TOP TEMPS AROUND -70C. SMALL-SCALE CIRCULATIONS ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF THE SQLN...FROM THE WARM FRONT IN SWRN WI WWD ACROSS THE VERY UNSTABLE AIRMASS ACROSS SRN MN...MAY BE ASSOCIATED WITH A GREATER STRONG/SEVERE WIND POTENTIAL...ESPECIALLY AS STRONGER MID/UPPER FLOW AND FORCING MOVE TOWARD THESE AREAS FROM THE WEST OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AT LEAST A MODEST THREAT FOR A FEW STRONG TO DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL PERSIST NEXT COUPLE HOURS MAINLY OVER ERN HALF OF REMAINING PORTION OF WW FROM EXTREME SERN MN THROUGH WCNTRL AND SWRN WI INTO EXTREME NERN IA. AT THIS TIME THE OVERALL THREAT DOES NOT APPEAR PARTICULARLY ROBUST...AND ANY WW ISSUANCE DOWNSTREAM FROM CURRENT WW WILL ULTIMATELY DEPEND ON CONVECTIVE TRENDS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EXPANSIVE SQUALL LINE EXTENDS FROM NCNTRL WI SWWD THROUGH SERN MN AND IS MOVING SEWD AT 30-35 KT. LATEST OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS SHOWS A QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT FROM NERN IL NWWD THROUGH WCNTRL WI WHERE IT INTERSECTS THE SQUALL LINE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. THE STORMS WILL LIKELY CONTINUE SEWD AS A FORWARD PROPAGATING SYSTEM INTO NERN IA AND SWRN AND SCNTRL WI ALONG INSTABILITY GRADIENT WHERE CONVERGENCE IS ENHANCED BY THE INTERACTION OF A WSWLY LLJ AND THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. DEVELOPMENT INTO WRN PORTION OF WW WHERE GREATER INSTABILITY EXISTS WILL PROBABLY REMAIN LIMITED BY STRENGTH OF CAP. STORMS ARE EMBEDDED WITHIN MODEST /30-35 KT/ WLY DEEP LAYER WINDS WITH 25-35 KT CLOUD LAYER SHEAR. THE LINE REMAINS LARGELY SUB-SEVERE...AND A GENERAL INCREASE IN INTENSITY DOES NOT APPEAR LIKELY. HOWEVER...OCCASIONAL STRONG TO DAMAGING GUSTS REMAIN POSSIBLE...ESPECIALLY NEAR BOWING SEGMENT MOVING INTO SRN WI WHERE MERGERS ARE OCCURRING BETWEEN THE SQUALL LINE AND DOWNSTREAM ELEVATED STORMS FORMING WITHIN WARM ADVECTION WING. ..DIAL.. 07/13/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS MAY CONTINUE TO POSE SOME RISK FOR ISOLATED STRONG TO DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AS THEY DEVELOP SEWD THROUGH SRN WI AND NRN IL EARLY THIS MORNING. TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED...AND A WW ISSUANCE IS POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLY THIS MORNING A QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT EXTENDS FROM SRN IND THROUGH NERN IL INTO SCNTRL WI WHERE IT INTERSECTS A CONVECTIVELY ACTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. A SQUALL LINE EXTENDS FROM NERN WI SWWD THROUGH SWRN WI AND IS MOVING SEWD AT AROUND 35-40 KT. THE STRONGER STORMS WITHIN THIS LINE ARE OVER SCNTRL WI WHERE NUMEROUS MERGERS ARE OCCURRING BETWEEN STORMS WITHIN THE LINE AND STORMS DEVELOPING DOWNSTREAM WITHIN ZONE OF ISENTROPIC ASCENT AND LOW-LEVEL WARM ADVECTION. THE INTERACTION OF A SWLY LLJ AND THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY SHOULD MAINTAIN THE LINE SEWD ALONG INSTABILITY GRADIENT NEXT FEW HOURS WHERE THE ATMOSPHERE REMAINS MODERATELY UNSTABLE /1500-2000 J/KG MLCAPE/ OVER NRN IL. CURRENT VWP FROM CHICAGO INDICATES MODEST /20-30 KT/ WINDS IN THE 1-4 KM LAYER. HOWEVER...A BELT OF 35-45 KT MID-LEVEL WINDS WITHIN THE BASE OF AN UPPER TROUGH LOCATED OVER THE UPPER MS VALLEY WILL GRADUALLY SPREAD EWD INTO NRN IL THIS MORNING WHICH WILL CONTRIBUTE TO AN INCREASE IN EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR. SOME OF THE STORMS WITHIN THE LINE REMAIN SEVERE...AND THERE IS SOME POTENTIAL ACTIVITY COULD BECOME BETTER ORGANIZED OR AT LEAST MAINTAIN THEIR INTENSITY AS THEY DEVELOP SEWD.
